description:
**Junior Graphic Designer**

**Company:** Techfied.in  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Location:** Wave Galleria, Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh  
**Salary:** ₹5,000–₹25,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio  
**Working Schedule:** 5.5 days per week

About Techfied.in

Techfied.in is an IT and marketing solutions company that helps small businesses grow through customised websites, mobile applications, social media growth solutions, and marketing campaigns.

We aim to provide small business owners with the digital solutions they need to build their online presence and grow their businesses.

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented **Junior Graphic Designer** to join our team and create engaging visual content for our company and clients. The role primarily focuses on social media creatives, website graphics, and advertising creatives, with opportunities to work on diverse projects across different industries and business requirements.

Role Overview

As a Junior Graphic Designer at Techfied.in, you will be responsible for translating creative ideas and marketing objectives into visually appealing designs.

Your primary focus will be social media posts, website graphics, banners, and ad creatives. You may also work on branding, presentations, print materials, product graphics, and UI/UX-related projects based on client requirements.

We welcome candidates at all experience levels. Your portfolio, practical design skills, creativity, and suitability for the role will be important considerations during the selection process.

Key Responsibilities

* **Social Media Design:** Create engaging social media posts, promotional creatives, and branded visual content for different businesses.
* **Website Graphics:** Design website banners, landing page visuals, web graphics, and other digital assets.
* **Ad Creatives:** Develop compelling visuals for paid advertising campaigns, keeping the target audience and marketing objectives in mind.
* **Branding and Identity:** Assist with logo design, brand assets, and maintaining visual consistency across different platforms.
* **Creative Project Execution:** Work on varied projects with different design requirements, industries, brand identities, and target audiences.
* **Marketing-Focused Design:** Convert marketing ideas and business requirements into effective visual communication.
* **Additional Design Work:** Create presentations, pitch decks, brochures, flyers, YouTube thumbnails, product graphics, infographics, and other creative assets as required.
* **Collaboration:** Understand project briefs, coordinate with team members, incorporate feedback, and make revisions when needed.
* **Quality and Deadlines:** Maintain design quality, follow brand guidelines, manage assigned tasks, and deliver work within agreed timelines.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Creativity and the ability to develop original design concepts.
* A good understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, layout, and visual hierarchy.
* Familiarity with graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Canva.
* Ability to understand design briefs and turn ideas into effective visual creatives.
* An understanding of how design communicates messages and engages audiences.
* Attention to detail and consistency across different design formats.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with a team when required.
* Willingness to accept feedback and improve designs through revisions.
* Good communication skills in Hindi and English.
* A portfolio demonstrating design ability and creative thinking.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with Adobe InDesign.
* Experience creating social media creatives and paid advertising visuals.
* Experience designing website banners, landing page graphics, and other web assets.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools and workflows.
* An understanding of branding, digital marketing, and audience psychology.
* Exposure to UI/UX design, logos, presentations, brochures, or infographics.

Experience Requirements

We are open to candidates at **all experience levels**, including freshers, self-taught designers, freelancers, and experienced professionals.

Candidates will be evaluated based on their portfolio, design fundamentals, creativity, relevant skills, and ability to handle the responsibilities of the role. Practical projects and personal work may be included in the portfolio.

Salary and Working Schedule

* **Salary:** ₹5,000–₹25,000 per month.
* **Salary Criteria:** Compensation will depend on the candidate's experience, demonstrated skills, portfolio quality, and suitability for the role.
* **Employment Type:** Full-time.
* **Working Schedule:** 5.5 days per week.
* **Work Mode:** On-site.
* **Office Location:** Wave Galleria, Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who enjoys creating designs, understands the importance of visual communication, takes ownership of their work, and is willing to work on a variety of creative projects.

Whether you are starting your career or already have professional experience, we encourage you to apply if your portfolio demonstrates your creativity, design skills, and ability to understand different project requirements.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Furniture Designer
description:
**Job Description: Furniture Designer & Production Supervisor**

**Location:** Sahibabad  
**Industry:** Furniture Manufacturing / Modular Furniture / Interior Fit-Out  
**Department:** Design & Production  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Work From Office / Factory Visits

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and hands-on Furniture Designer & Production Supervisor to manage furniture designing, technical drawings, vendor coordination, and production supervision. The candidate will ensure that furniture is manufactured according to approved designs, dimensions, materials, finishes, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

The role requires regular visits to production units and vendor factories across Delhi-NCR to monitor production progress, inspect quality, and ensure timely delivery of furniture orders.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Furniture Designing & Technical Drawings**

* Prepare 2D drawings, 3D models, and detailed furniture shop drawings.
* Design customized and modular furniture as per client requirements.
* Prepare technical drawings with accurate dimensions, materials, finishes, hardware, and construction details.
* Design wardrobes, cabinets, tables, workstations, chairs, storage units, and other interior furniture.
* Coordinate with clients, architects, interior designers, and production teams to finalize designs.
* Revise drawings according to client feedback and site requirements.
* Ensure all drawings and specifications are approved before production begins.

**2. Production Supervision & Quality Control**

* Supervise furniture manufacturing at factories and vendor locations.
* Ensure production follows approved drawings, dimensions, materials, and finish samples.
* Inspect furniture for quality, workmanship, hardware fitting, finishing, and dimensional accuracy.
* Identify production defects and coordinate corrective actions.
* Monitor carpentry, fabrication, assembly, polishing, finishing, and installation activities.
* Maintain quality standards throughout the production process.

**3. Vendor Coordination & Order Tracking**

* Coordinate with vendors, carpenters, fabricators, production teams, and suppliers.
* Track furniture orders from drawing approval and raw material procurement to production, inspection, and dispatch.
* Follow up on production schedules and ensure timely delivery.
* Identify delays, material shortages, and production issues and report them to management.
* Maintain regular communication with vendors to ensure smooth execution of orders.

**4. Site Visits & Installation Coordination**

* Visit production units, vendor factories, and project sites across Delhi-NCR.
* Verify site measurements and ensure furniture fits the approved layout.
* Coordinate furniture installation and resolve design or execution-related issues.
* Ensure completed furniture meets client expectations and project specifications.

**5. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain updated drawings, material specifications, finish samples, and production records.
* Prepare production status reports and track order completion.
* Coordinate with management regarding design approvals, quality issues, and delivery schedules.

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in AutoCAD and furniture design software such as SketchUp, 3ds Max, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of furniture construction, modular furniture, hardware, materials, and finishes.
* Knowledge of technical drawings, shop drawings, and production processes.
* Experience in vendor management, production supervision, and quality inspection.
* Good coordination, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and dimensions.
* Willingness to travel to factories and project sites across Delhi-NCR.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Education:** Diploma or Degree in Interior Design, Furniture Design, Product Design, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Relevant experience in furniture designing and production supervision.
* **Industry Preference:** Furniture manufacturing, modular furniture, interior fit-outs, or turnkey interior projects.
* **Location:** Candidates comfortable working from Sahibabad and travelling across Delhi-NCR.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of furniture drawings and measurements.
* Quality of finished furniture and adherence to approved specifications.
* Timely completion and delivery of orders.
* Effective vendor coordination and production monitoring.
* Reduction in production errors, material wastage, and rework.

**Ideal Candidate:** A practical, detail-oriented professional who can handle both furniture design and on-ground production supervision, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely project completion.

Pay: Up to ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: On the road

title: Conversion UX Strategist
description:
Job Title: Conversion UX Strategist

*Funnel Planning · Landing Pages · AI-Assisted UI*

Job Description

**Please read before applying.**

This is **not a website designer or website developer role**. We are not looking for someone whose primary responsibility is building or coding websites. We need someone who thinks strategically, understands the client’s business, plans the customer journey, and designs landing pages that generate enquiries.

As a Conversion UX Strategist, you will plan and design landing pages for our advertising campaigns. You will research the client’s business, understand the campaign objective and target audience, map the journey from ad click to enquiry, prepare a strategy for client approval, and then use AI tools to turn the approved plan into landing-page designs.

**Strategy comes first. Design comes second.** The goal is to create purposeful, mobile-first landing pages that align with the ad message and encourage visitors to take action.

What You’ll Do

* **Business & USP Research:** Understand the client’s product or service, key differentiators, value proposition, and competitive advantages.
* **Campaign Goal Analysis:** Identify the campaign’s primary objective, whether it is generating phone calls, WhatsApp enquiries, form submissions, or bookings.
* **Target Audience Research:** Define the ideal audience, their problems, needs, motivations, concerns, and reasons to trust the business.
* **Competitor Analysis:** Review competitor landing pages, offers, messaging, and ads to identify gaps, opportunities, and useful insights.
* **Funnel Planning:** Map the complete journey from ad click to landing page, enquiry form or contact action, and thank-you page.
* **Landing-Page Strategy:** Plan the page structure, including headlines, offers, benefits, social proof, reviews, certifications, FAQs, and calls to action.
* **Conversion-Focused Content Planning:** Ensure each section has a clear purpose and moves visitors towards the intended action.
* **Strategy Documentation & Wireframing:** Prepare a clear strategy document with the proposed page journey, section-by-section structure, messaging direction, CTA logic, and wireframes.
* **Client Presentation & Approval:** Explain the strategy, justify key decisions, gather feedback, and secure client approval before design begins.
* **AI-Assisted UI Design:** Use AI design tools to create landing-page layouts and interfaces quickly, following a mobile-first approach and maintaining consistency between the ad message and landing-page content.
* **Cross-Team Coordination:** Work with the ads team and developers to support implementation, launch, and enquiry tracking.
* **Performance Analysis:** Review post-launch results, identify conversion barriers, and recommend improvements to generate more enquiries.

Tools & Platforms

Familiarity with relevant tools such as the following is beneficial:

* AI-assisted UI and wireframing tools
* Google Docs and Google Sheets
* Landing-page and funnel planning tools
* Website analytics and conversion tracking tools
* Advertising platforms and campaign reporting dashboards
* Collaboration and project management tools

You do not need to be a developer, but you should understand how landing pages are implemented and how enquiry tracking works.

Experience

Candidates with experience in conversion-focused UX, landing-page strategy, funnel planning, CRO, digital marketing, or AI-assisted UI design are preferred.

Practical experience planning landing pages for advertising campaigns and understanding their enquiry performance will be an advantage. Candidates should be able to explain the objective, strategy, structure, and results of their previous work.

Who Can Apply

This role is suited to candidates who:

* Ask about the business goal and target audience before starting the design.
* Can explain the conversion purpose behind every section of a landing page.
* Have experience planning customer journeys for paid advertising campaigns.
* Can prepare clear strategy documents and wireframes for client review and approval.
* Understand how messaging, offers, trust elements, and CTAs influence enquiries.
* Are comfortable using AI tools to create wireframes and UI designs efficiently.
* Can collaborate with advertising and development teams to support launch and optimisation.

This Role Is Not for You If

* Your primary experience is building websites on WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or similar platforms, or coding in HTML/CSS.
* You begin projects by selecting a template or designing the page before understanding the business objective.
* Your portfolio contains only website screenshots, without explaining the strategy, conversion goal, or results.
* You have never prepared a client-facing plan, strategy document, or wireframe for approval.
* You focus on visual appearance without considering the customer journey and conversion objective.

Skills

* Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
* Landing-Page Strategy
* Funnel Planning
* Conversion-Focused UX
* Customer Journey Mapping
* Target Audience Research
* Customer Intent and Behaviour Analysis
* Competitor Landing-Page Analysis
* Unique Selling Proposition (USP) Research
* Campaign Objective Analysis
* Landing-Page Content Structuring
* Information Architecture
* Conversion Copywriting
* Headline and Offer Strategy
* Call-to-Action (CTA) Planning
* Lead Generation Strategy
* Enquiry Funnel Design
* Wireframing and UI Planning
* AI-Assisted UI Design
* Mobile-First Design Thinking
* Trust and Credibility Planning
* Form and Thank-You Page Planning
* Ad-to-Landing-Page Message Alignment
* Enquiry Tracking and Conversion Analysis
* Landing-Page Performance Optimisation
* Strategy Documentation
* Google Docs and Sheets
* Client Communication and Presentation
* Cross-Team Coordination
* Analytical and Strategic Thinking
* Independent Decision-Making

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

* Understand the target audience, including their needs, pain points, expectations, objections, and reasons to trust a business.
* Review competitor landing pages and advertisements to identify gaps, useful insights, and opportunities for differentiation.
* Align the landing page strategy with the client's business goals and advertising campaign.

2. Conversion Funnel & User Journey Planning

* Plan the complete conversion journey from **ad → landing page → enquiry form → thank-you page**.
* Determine what visitors should see first and how each section should move them toward the desired action.
* Develop the page structure, including headlines, offers, benefits, trust signals, supporting content, and calls to action (CTAs).
* Decide which sections are necessary, what information each section should communicate, and how the content should be prioritized.
* Plan enquiry forms and conversion steps according to the campaign objective.
* Ensure the landing page message matches the advertisement that brings visitors to the page.
* Explain the conversion logic behind each major structural and messaging decision.

3. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval

* Prepare a clear, structured strategy document outlining the recommended landing page approach.
* Create wireframes that communicate the page layout, content hierarchy, section sequence, and conversion flow.
* Document the campaign goal, target audience, key messaging, USP, offer, CTAs, and trust elements.
* Explain why each section is included and how it supports the visitor's journey toward an enquiry.
* Share the strategy document and wireframes with the client for review and approval before design begins.
* Identify missing information and ask the client relevant questions before finalizing the plan.
* Incorporate feedback and refine the strategy when required.

4. AI-Assisted Landing Page Design

* Use AI-assisted design tools to turn approved strategies and wireframes into landing page UI designs.
* Create mobile-first layouts that are clear, user-friendly, and aligned with the campaign objective.
* Maintain consistency between the ad message, landing page content, offer, and CTA.
* Apply conversion-focused principles to content hierarchy, page flow, readability, and user experience.
* Ensure the final design follows the approved strategy rather than starting with a template or visual concept.

5. Launch Coordination & Conversion Optimization

* Coordinate with the advertising team and developers to support landing page launch.
* Ensure the intended enquiry actions and tracking requirements are communicated clearly.
* Work with the relevant team members to support enquiry tracking for calls, WhatsApp, forms, or bookings.
* Review post-launch performance and available conversion data.
* Identify potential friction points and recommend changes to improve enquiry generation.
* Suggest improvements to page messaging, structure, forms, CTAs, and user journey based on campaign results.

Required Skills & Experience

* Strong understanding of conversion-focused landing pages and funnel planning.
* Ability to understand business goals, campaign objectives, customer intent, and target audiences.
* Experience planning landing pages for paid advertising campaigns.
* Knowledge of landing page structure, wireframes, content hierarchy, CTAs, and trust-building elements.
* Ability to analyze competitor pages and advertising messages.
* Strong research, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prepare clear strategy documents and wireframes that clients can understand and approve.
* Confidence in explaining the reasoning behind page structure and design decisions.
* Practical familiarity with AI tools for wireframing and UI design.
* Understanding of mobile-first design and enquiry tracking.
* Ability to collaborate with advertising teams and developers during implementation.

Who Should Apply?

This role is suitable for candidates with experience or skills in:

* Conversion rate optimization (CRO)
* UX strategy and user journey mapping
* Landing page and funnel planning
* Conversion-focused UI/UX design
* Digital marketing and paid advertising funnels
* AI-assisted wireframing and interface design
* Landing page performance analysis

Candidates must be comfortable handling both **strategic planning and AI-assisted page design**. Pure design execution without an understanding of conversion goals is not sufficient.

This Role Is NOT for You If

* Your primary work is building websites on WordPress, Shopify, or Wix, or coding in HTML/CSS.
* You begin projects by choosing a template or creating the visual design before understanding the business goal.
* Your portfolio contains only website screenshots without explaining the objective, strategy, or outcomes.
* You have never prepared a landing page plan or strategy document for a client.
* You cannot explain why particular sections, messages, trust elements, or CTAs are included on a page.

This Role IS for You If

* You ask, **"What is the goal, and who is the audience?"** before opening a design tool.
* You can independently plan the journey from an advertisement to a completed enquiry.
* You understand why each landing page section exists and how it contributes to conversion.
* You have planned landing pages for advertising campaigns and can discuss their enquiry or conversion performance.
* You can prepare a clear, practical strategy document that a client can review and approve.
* You are comfortable using AI tools to create wireframes and UI designs efficiently.
* You use research, campaign objectives, customer needs, and performance data to guide your decisions.

Portfolio Expectations

Applicants should be prepared to demonstrate landing page projects that show more than the final design. Relevant examples should explain:

* The client's business and campaign objective.
* The target audience and key customer insights.
* The planned funnel and landing page structure.
* The reasoning behind the messaging, sections, trust elements, and CTAs.
* The wireframes or strategy document, where available.
* The results achieved, such as enquiries or conversion performance, where available.

Role Objective

Your primary objective is to **plan, design, and improve landing pages that turn advertising traffic into enquiries**.

Success means understanding the business before designing, producing a strategy the client can approve, creating a page aligned with the campaign, and using post-launch results to recommend meaningful improvements.
